cim: More people will use AI in their shopping this holiday season: Report
cim_eredeti: More people will use AI in their shopping this holiday season: Report
szoveg_eredeti:
(NewsNation) — As the holiday season approaches, more people are expected to use artificial intelligence for help with their shopping, according to PwC.

According to the company’s insights, 29% of shoppers plan to use AI for holiday research, up from 22% last year.

PwC data shows more people are integrating AI into their shopping, but it is “hardly a takeover.”

The company’s insights suggest that people will use the technology for various reasons, including research assistance, price comparison and budgeting.

According to PwC, around 75% of AI users use the technology to research products and gifts, and 55% use it to compare prices.

The company’s insights show millennials are expected to cut spending the most this holiday season, with gift spending down 10% and travel down 37%.
